description: The Bureau of Statistics Guyana publishes 2012 Population and Housing Census household tables at village level as a ZIP archive of 52 PDFs on its census page. Each table lists every village or neighbourhood by region with household counts for one topic: main source of lighting, split into public and private electricity, solar or inverter and kerosene; water supply and drinking water; toilets; cooking fuel; garbage disposal; outer wall and roofing material; dwelling type and ownership; working equipment such as solar panels, generators, water pumps and air conditioners; and household concern about flooding, drainage and water contamination. Compendium 5 adds regional tables on building stock, materials, year built, sanitation, water and lighting with changes since 2002. Coverage is national at village level. Format and access: free PDF and ZIP downloads, no registration; 2002 village tables and a preliminary 2022 report are also posted. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: village tables are PDFs that need parsing and have no village codes; 2022 results were only preliminary. Simulation uses: off-grid and solar electrification planning by village, and flood and drainage exposure of households. Related records: none for Guyana censuses in the catalogue.

schema_summary: Village tables (one PDF each): number of households; households by main source of lighting (gas lantern, kerosene, public electricity, private electricity, solar or inverter, other), water supply, drinking water, toilet facility, cooking fuel, garbage disposal, outer wall and roofing material, dwelling type, dwelling and land ownership; equipment in working condition (air conditioning, electrical generator, solar panel, water pump, water heater, internet, private vehicle and others); environmental concerns (flooding, drainage, water contamination, soil erosion, mangrove destruction and others); crime. Compendium 5 tables 5.1 to 5.32: building stock and dwelling units by region, dwelling type, wall and roof materials, year built and renovation, tenure, sanitation, water, cooking fuel, lighting and garbage.
